grid.layout_notes: Official 2-4-4-4-2 plus bottom special Big Balls row.

win_system.notes: Ways with xWays and Big Balls splits; exact count not printed.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: Avalanche when special-row symbols are in the win; special row refills from right with +1 Big Balls mult.

other.name: Big Balls Multiplier row
other.how_it_works: Bottom special row: symbols enter from right with incremental mult ×1,×2,…; symbols split by that mult.

other.name: xHole
other.how_it_works: Center position: suck main-reel symbols, spit as size 2–8 splits; converts to Wild. Preserves Gimp/Gimpier/Wild/xNudge/Kinky/Wife/prior wins; won't suck sticky Wilds in bonus or exact-3 Gimps.

other.name: Kinky Hookup
other.how_it_works: Kinky Kenneth + Kinky Wife on main reels → shortest path converts to Wife/Kenneth/Wild; pay before then after.

other.name: Gimp / Gimpier Transform
other.how_it_works: Exactly 2 Gimps → transform to Ways/Nudge/Wild/Kinky/Kenneth/Wife. Gimpier (reel 5) → Kinky Kenneth/Wild/Kinky Wife. Respawn on avalanche.

wilds.name: Wild
wilds.behavior: Sticky in Beefy+ on main reels.

wilds.name: xNudge Wild
wilds.behavior: Nudges up; +1 mult/step; +1 per Wild passed; multi-reel add; Big Balls mult if on special row; sticky in Beefier+.

scatters.name: Gimp / Gimpier
scatters.behavior: 3 Gimps → 8 Beefy; 3 Gimps+Gimpier → 9 Beefier; +activated xHole → 10 Beefiest. Upgrades mid-bonus via Gimpier/Hole.

multipliers.name: Big Balls / xNudge
multipliers.behavior: Special-row incremental; nudge mults add across reels; persist in Beefy (Big Balls does not reset).

base_game_loop.summary: Ways avalanches on 2-4-4-4-2 + Big Balls row. xNudge, xWays, xHole, Gimp transforms, Kinky Hookup. Max Win Cap Choice 10,000× or 69,000× (lower cap boosts xHole/Nudge/Ways odds). 3 Gimps → Beefy 8; +Gimpier → Beefier 9; +Hole → Beefiest 10. Buys 65–6,969×. Cap Death by Blue Baby.

phases.name: Configure cap / buys
phases.what_happens: Choose 10k or 69k max; optional Nolimit Bonus/Booster.

phases.name: Spin + features
phases.what_happens: Big Balls splits; Gimp transforms; Hookup; xHole; xNudge; avalanches on special-row wins.

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Ways after transforms/splits/nudges; Hookup pays twice (before/after).
base_game_loop.notes: CMS; concrete per-spin xBet cost not printed (generic blurb + buy band).

modes.name: Beefy Spins
modes.retrigger: Gimpier → Beefier +1; Gimpier+Hole same avalanche → Beefiest +2.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Big Balls mult does not reset; normal Wilds sticky on main reels.
modes.end_condition: Spins done or Death by Blue Baby cap.

phases.name: Enter
phases.what_happens: 8 spins; sticky Wilds; persistent Big Balls.

modes.name: Beefier Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Beefy + sticky Gimpier and Nudge Wilds.

modes.name: Beefiest Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Beefier + xHole reapplies at start of each spin.

features.name: xHole / xNudge / xWays
features.effects: Suck-spit splits; nudge mults; ways expand.

feature_buy.notes: Exact line-item costs inside band not printed.

ante_bet.notes: Generic xBet blurb without concrete multiplier on CMS.

numeric_limits.max_win_notes: Death by Blue Baby: 69,000× or 10,000× via Max Win Cap Choice
numeric_limits.rtp_notes: 96.04% from official page title (may vary with cap mode).

evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Beefy 8 / Beefier 9 / Beefiest 10; Cap Choice 10k/69k; buys 65-6969×.
